introduction: ERC-8001 defines a minimal, single-chain primitive for multi-party coordination between autonomous agents. It was proposed by Kwame Bryan in August 2025. An initiator posts an EIP-712 signed intent naming a canonical list of participants, and each participant returns a verifiable acceptance attestation. Once every required acceptance is present and unexpired, the intent becomes executable. The standard fixes the typed data, lifecycle, and mandatory events so agents can agree on-chain without a trusted coordinator.
designPurpose: ERC-8001 was designed to fill a gap in intent standards such as ERC-7683, which describe single-initiator flows and do not specify how several agents reach a joint agreement. Before it, agents in DeFi, MEV, or gaming had to rely on a trusted coordinator or bespoke contracts to act together. The design separates the initiator's intent from each participant's acceptance, so signatures collect off-chain and are verified in one on-chain check, while canonical participant lists and monotonic nonces prevent replay.
commonUsage: ERC-8001 targets autonomous agents that must act jointly, such as MEV searchers coordinating a shared strategy, DeFi bots aligning on a multi-step action, or agents in Web3 gaming and agentic commerce. Because it is a minimal core, it is meant to be extended: the specification leaves out privacy, reputation, thresholds, bonding, and cross-chain semantics, expecting optional modules to reference it. Both contract and EOA wallets can participate, since acceptances validate through ECDSA or ERC-1271 signatures.
fn.proposeCoordination.desc: Registers a new coordination intent signed by the initiator, marks it Proposed, and emits CoordinationProposed. Reverts on an invalid signature, an expired intent, a non-increasing nonce, or a non-canonical participant list.
fn.proposeCoordination.params.intent: The AgentIntent struct holding the payload hash, expiry, nonce, initiator, coordination type, value, and sorted participant list.
fn.proposeCoordination.params.signature: The initiator's ECDSA or ERC-1271 signature over the EIP-712 intent digest.
fn.proposeCoordination.params.payload: The CoordinationPayload whose keccak256 hash must equal the intent's payloadHash.
fn.proposeCoordination.returns.intentHas: The struct hash of the intent, used as its identifier in later calls.
fn.acceptCoordination.desc: Records a participant's signed acceptance and emits CoordinationAccepted, returning true and marking the intent Ready once every participant has accepted. Reverts for a non-participant, duplicate acceptance, or expired attestation.
fn.acceptCoordination.params.intentHash: The identifier of the intent being accepted.
fn.acceptCoordination.params.attestation: The AcceptanceAttestation struct with the participant's signature, conditions hash, and expiry.
fn.acceptCoordination.returns.allAccepte: True when this acceptance completes the required set and the intent becomes Ready.
fn.executeCoordination.desc: Executes a Ready intent, runs the behaviour encoded in executionData, and emits CoordinationExecuted. Reverts if the intent is not Ready, the intent or an acceptance has expired, or the payload does not match payloadHash.
fn.executeCoordination.params.intentHash: The identifier of the Ready intent to execute.
fn.executeCoordination.params.payload: The CoordinationPayload; its keccak256 hash must equal the intent's payloadHash.
fn.executeCoordination.params.executionD: Opaque data describing the behaviour the implementation should carry out.
fn.executeCoordination.returns.result: The raw bytes returned by the executed behaviour.
fn.cancelCoordination.desc: Cancels an intent and emits CoordinationCancelled, setting its status to Cancelled. Before expiry only the proposer may cancel; after expiry any caller may cancel.
fn.cancelCoordination.params.intentHash: The identifier of the intent to cancel.
fn.cancelCoordination.params.reason: A human-readable string describing why the intent was cancelled.
fn.getCoordinationStatus.desc: Returns the lifecycle status of an intent along with its proposer, full participant list, the participants that have accepted, and its expiry. Reports None for an unknown intent.
fn.getCoordinationStatus.params.intentHa: The identifier of the intent to query.
fn.getCoordinationStatus.returns.status: The lifecycle status: None, Proposed, Ready, Executed, Cancelled, or Expired.
fn.getCoordinationStatus.returns.propose: The address that proposed the intent.
fn.getCoordinationStatus.returns.partici: The full canonical list of participant addresses.
fn.getCoordinationStatus.returns.accepte: The subset of participants that have submitted a valid acceptance.
fn.getCoordinationStatus.returns.expiry: The intent's expiry timestamp in unix seconds.
fn.CoordinationProposed.desc: Emitted when an intent is proposed, recording its hash, proposer, coordination type, participant count, and coordination value.
fn.CoordinationProposed.params.intentHas: The struct hash identifying the proposed intent.
fn.CoordinationProposed.params.proposer: The initiator that signed and posted the intent.
fn.CoordinationProposed.params.coordinat: The domain-specific type identifier for the coordination.
fn.CoordinationProposed.params.participa: The number of participants required to accept.
fn.CoordinationProposed.params.coordinat: The informational coordination value carried by the intent.
fn.CoordinationAccepted.desc: Emitted when a participant accepts an intent, recording the acceptance hash and the running accepted-versus-required counts.
fn.CoordinationAccepted.params.intentHas: The identifier of the intent being accepted.
fn.CoordinationAccepted.params.participa: The participant that submitted the acceptance.
fn.CoordinationAccepted.params.acceptanc: The struct hash of the acceptance attestation.
fn.CoordinationAccepted.params.acceptedC: The number of participants that have accepted so far.
fn.CoordinationAccepted.params.requiredC: The total number of acceptances required.
fn.CoordinationExecuted.desc: Emitted when a Ready intent is executed, recording the executor, whether execution succeeded, the gas used, and the returned result.
fn.CoordinationExecuted.params.intentHas: The identifier of the executed intent.
fn.CoordinationExecuted.params.gasUsed: The amount of gas consumed by the execution.
fn.CoordinationExecuted.params.result: The raw bytes returned by the executed behaviour.
fn.CoordinationCancelled.desc: Emitted when an intent is cancelled, recording the canceller, a reason string, and the final status code of the intent.
fn.CoordinationCancelled.params.intentHa: The identifier of the cancelled intent.
fn.CoordinationCancelled.params.cancelle: The address that cancelled the intent.
fn.CoordinationCancelled.params.reason: A human-readable explanation for the cancellation.
fn.CoordinationCancelled.params.finalSta: The numeric status code the intent ended in.
sim.proposeCoordinationWalkthrough.name: Propose Coordination Walkthrough
sim.proposeCoordinationWalkthrough.desc: Follow a proposeCoordination call from the initiator through intent storage to the CoordinationProposed event.
The initiator signs an AgentIntent under the ERC-8001 EIP-712 domain and calls proposeCoordination with the intent, signature, and payload.
The coordinator verifies the signature, the canonical participant list, and the nonce, then records the intent as Proposed and bumps the initiator's nonce.
The coordinator emits CoordinationProposed with the intent hash, proposer, type, participant count, and value so participants can discover and accept it.
